title: Strengthening Singaporean Core in Nursing Profession
what_it_is: Strengthening Singaporean Core in Nursing Profession

sections.label: Nursing salaries and support
sections.summary: Nursing salaries in public healthcare were enhanced by 5% to 14% in 2021, with community care funding support and annual Nurse Special Payment reviews.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As I mentioned yesterday in my Committee of Supply speech, in 2021, we enhanced nursing salaries in the public healthcare sector by 5% to 14%, to be implemented over two years, including one tranche that will be given out this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We had also increased funding support to the community care sector to ensure that nurses' salaries in the community care sector remain competitive as well.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Beyond base salaries, nurses also receive the Nurse Special Payment (NSP) in December every year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The NSP quantum is reviewed annually to ensure that nursing pay remains attractive.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Through competitive salaries and non-monetary means, we will ensure that nursing remains a viable career prospect for Singaporeans.
